title: Why the family moved to Pittsburgh and where they lived
summary: The family followed relatives to Pittsburgh. Her mother married Fletcher Burley about a year later, and they moved through three or four homes in East Liberty.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So that gets us up into Pittsburgh. Why did your mother leave Atlanta?
Well, I don't know. I think they just moved away because they had a yearning to go. My grandmother's sister, all her sisters, had moved I guess years previously

and so they decided to go and move to Philadelphia, also her mother, my grandmother Mrs.(Rouser)- Anna Jane(Rouser) rather - and her mother was also there, the Parkers, and her father, in Pittsburgh, so I think they decided to go there to be with the family.
So you're maybe roughly 4 years old when you get to Pittsburgh?
What was the family life like then? Your mother was not married at this point?
No, I think she married Fletcher Burley about a year later.
And she was living with her sister?
She was living with her aunt, my grandmother's sister.
I see. When she married Fletcher Burley did she still live there or did you all move somewhere else?

We lived there for a while. I started to school there and then we moved to Euclid Avenue in East Liberty; later on Wilmington Avenue and Hamilton Avenue after that. We moved about 3 different places before the family really became settled.
